title: meaning@1: the shared units of meaning
description: meaning/meanings.jsonl. The first line is the header; every later line is one unit of meaning, written once and language-neutral. Sentences, language columns and vocabulary links point at these ids.

notes.description: How the meanings are written, one sentence or line each.

id.description: Unique. A grammar meaning starts with "@".

kind.description: content: a thing, action or quality English has to say. grammar: a job in the sentence that English often shows with word order or not at all.

label.description: What a grammar meaning does, e.g. "topic marker". Required for grammar.

en.description: English words or phrases that may carry it, most usual first. A grammar meaning may have none.

group.description: Where it sits in the list, e.g. "People".
